payload.reason: The evidence indicates that RR-based fingerprint construction significantly enhances the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in detecting forced climate signals. Without this method, the ability to isolate forced responses from internal variability would be compromised, leading to lower detection confidence and potentially missing significant trends.

claims.text: RR-based fingerprint construction improves the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for detecting forced climate signals.
Without RR-based fingerprint construction, the detection of forced changes would be less robust due to higher influence from internal variability.
